notes.title: New free co-op puzzle game announcement!
notes.content:
[h2]Our New Game: FOCUS GROUP – A 2-player Puzzle Adventure is coming![/h2][p]Hey everyone!
We’re excited to finally share what we’ve been working on next:[/p][p][b]FOCUS GROUP[/b] is a two-player co-op puzzle game set in a twisted corporate testing offices in the 1980s. You and a partner are part of a product testing program run by [i]Compliance Forge[/i], a faceless mega-corporation. The job? Solve bizarre experimental puzzles and explore the eerie facility while doing it.[/p][p]It’s designed from the ground up for [b]co-op only[/b]—you’ll each see different information and have to talk through every solution. No hand-holding, no tutorials, just communication, logic, and a little panic ;)

[previewyoutube="7tdVY_hOE-o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Expect:
✔ Asymmetrical co-op puzzles
✔ No tutorials, only corporate expectations
✔ Strictly internal collaboration – no solo applicants accepted
✔ Unforgettable synergy-building scenarios (some of which may be on fire)

[h2]Wishlist the free prologue[/h2][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886940/"][/dynamiclink]

[h2]Wishlist the main game[/h2][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3864690/"][/dynamiclink]

Stay sharp!
Clem

notes.title: Sanctuary is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Sanctuary is LIVE – Retrieve the Relics[/h1]

[b]First-person escape-room puzzler for 1–4 players. Average play-time : 60–90 minutes.[/b]

[previewyoutube=4ZvfYiWh0iQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The gates of the abandoned convent have opened at last – [i]Mad Experiments: Escape Room – Sanctuary[/i] is out now with a 25 % launch discount running until 2 June 2025. Rally your crew, light the candles and prove you are worthy of the Brotherhood’s secrets!

[list]
[*]Seamless cross-platform co-op – PC, Mac & Linux players team up instantly.
[*]Three-relic quest – unite the Horn of the Fallen One, Scepter of Radiance and Abbot’s Ring to break the final seal.
[*]Signature set-piece puzzles – bend mirror-guided light beams, ring bell melodies and rebuild the abbots’ chronology.
[*]Hidden-prison finale – uncover a sealed passage for one last, pulse-pounding challenge.
[*]Fully voiced narrative – playable with subtitles in 10 languages.
[/list]

Thank you for wish-listing, testing and cheering us on. Seeing you unravel our toughest rituals together means the world to the team.

See you inside the convent!
